topic_title: Value of Responsible Reduced-Risk Driving Practices
prompt: How does adopting a reduced-risk driving philosophy protect more than just the individual driver?

options.text: Guarantees the driver will never receive a jury duty summons from county clerks
Protects innocent passengers, pedestrians, and fellow motorists sharing the highway
Provides automatic exemption from municipal property taxes on personal dwellings
Ensures the driver's vehicle will never suffer unexpected mechanical breakdowns
